### 💻 Ejercicio del Día
```go
// Crear un programa que gestione una lista de tareas (tasks)
// con operaciones CRUD básicas usando structs

package main

import (
    "fmt"
)

type Task struct {
    ID      int
    Title   string
    Done    bool
}

type TaskManager struct {
    tasks []Task
    nextID int
}

func NewTaskManager() *TaskManager {
    return &TaskManager{
        tasks:  []Task{},
        nextID: 1,
    }
}

func (tm *TaskManager) AddTask(title string) Task {
    task := Task{
        ID:    tm.nextID,
        Title: title,
        Done:  false,
    }
    tm.tasks = append(tm.tasks, task)
    tm.nextID++
    return task
}

func (tm *TaskManager) ListTasks() []Task {
    return tm.tasks
}

func (tm *TaskManager) CompleteTask(id int) bool {
    for i, task := range tm.tasks {
        if task.ID == id {
            tm.tasks[i].Done = true
            return true
        }
    }
    return false
}

func main() {
    manager := NewTaskManager()
    
    // Agregar tareas
    t1 := manager.AddTask("Aprender Go")
    t2 := manager.AddTask("Aprender React")
    t3 := manager.AddTask("Construir API")
    
    fmt.Printf("Tareas creadas: %d\n", len(manager.ListTasks()))
    
    // Marcar como completada
    manager.CompleteTask(t2.ID)
    
    // Listar todas
    for _, task := range manager.ListTasks() {
        status := "Pendiente"
        if task.Done {
            status = "Completada"
        }
        fmt.Printf("[%d] %s - %s\n", task.ID, task.Title, status)
    }
}
```
